name: coverage-driver
//: The coverage driver, coverage.sh (the per-crate instrumented test runs and the merged report the coverage gate project runs), and its self-tests. Nothing depends on it but the coverage gate, so only an edit to the driver selects its slow self-tests.

test.//suppression: llmlint: ignore-block[shell_test_tiers_stay_split] this project holds one script, coverage.sh, which exists only to drive cargo-llvm-cov and nextest; its offline and its host-tool tiers are the same thing, so no unrelated script edit can pay for this suite, and only an edit to the driver (or the cargo/cargo-llvm-cov/nextest versions, runtime inputs of this cached target) reruns it
test.//: The driver against a scratch Cargo workspace under the real cargo-llvm-cov: profiles combine across crates, the floor fails below 95%, and bad input is a usage error.
